description: IMS Phase B — Contractor Payments, Performance Dashboards, Suspension Workflows, and Document Automation. Extends Phase A (profiles, onboarding, documents, RAG, project assignment).

features.description: Record and track payments made to contractors per project assignment. New contractor_payments table. Add payments tab to contractor detail page. Show total paid vs contract value on assignment cards.
success_criteria: Can record a payment against a contractor_projects record via POST /api/contractors/[id]/payments
Payment history tab on contractor detail page renders with real data
Total paid vs contract value shown on contractor-project assignment card
Payments list filterable by status and date range
Payment list exportable as CSV

features.description: Full invoice and progress claim workflow. Stages: submitted → under_review → approved → paid / rejected. Line items stored as JSONB. Approved invoices optionally create AP journal entries in the accounting module.
success_criteria: Can create an invoice with line items against a contractor-project assignment
Status transitions enforced at API level
Rejected invoices capture rejection reason
Invoice list page shows all invoices with status and contractor filters
Invoice detail view shows full line items and status change history

features.description: Complete the contractor detail page with a full 6-tab UI: Overview, Documents, Projects, Payments, Performance, Suspension History.
success_criteria: All 6 tabs render without error with real data
Documents tab embeds existing SingleContractorReport component inline
Projects tab shows contractor_projects assignment history
Payments tab shows payment records
Performance tab shows 4+ KPI stats
Suspension History tab shows contractor_suspension_history records

features.description: Dedicated analytics page aggregating contractor performance KPIs. Filterable by date range and province. Sortable contractor league table. CSV export.
success_criteria: Dashboard loads within 2 seconds with real aggregated data
Shows 6+ KPIs using EnhancedStatCard
Contractor league table sortable by any KPI column
Date range and province filters
CSV export of full performance dataset

features.description: Formal suspension and reinstatement workflow with PDF suspension letter, compliance checklist, and full audit trail in contractor_suspension_history.
success_criteria: Suspend modal requires reason (min 20 chars)
Suspension letter PDF generated and stored via VF Storage
H&S gate blocks suspended contractors from project assignment
Reinstatement flow shows compliance checklist
All events stored in contractor_suspension_history

features.description: Generate branded PDF appointment letter on contractor-project assignment. Stored in VF Storage, versioned on re-generation.
success_criteria: Generate button on assignment card triggers PDF creation
PDF contains contractor, project, contract value, and scope details
Stored via VF Storage; path saved to contractor_projects record
PDF viewable inline via document proxy
Re-generation preserves previous version path

features.description: Import bulk CSV payment statement, reconcile against open invoices, preview before commit, download discrepancy report.
success_criteria: Upload accepts CSV with amount, reference, date columns
Preview shows matched, unmatched, and ambiguous counts
Commit applies matched payments atomically
Discrepancy report downloadable as CSV
Import history stored

features.description: Scheduled alert job for documents expiring at 30/14/7-day thresholds. Dedup via contractor_alert_history. Counts on RAG dashboard.
success_criteria: POST /api/contractors/send-expiry-alerts triggers check
One alert per contractor per document per threshold
Alert history stored in contractor_alert_history
RAG dashboard shows expiry alert count badge

features.description: Branded printable PDF scorecard per contractor with RAG status, 6 KPIs, document compliance summary, recent payments. Downloadable from Overview tab.
success_criteria: Generated within 5 seconds
All sections present: company details, RAG, 6 KPIs, doc compliance, recent payments
FibreFlow branding applied
Server-side generation, downloadable from Overview tab

features.description: CSV import to batch-update contractor onboarding stage statuses after document review. Preview, validate, commit, log.
success_criteria: CSV template downloadable
Preview table shows old vs new status per row
Invalid rows excluded with error messages
Commit applies valid rows in single transaction
Result summary shown
